name: ice slopes + box: Box 2 rises · 46t at (4, 14, 3)
description:
One Up command in a 16×16 room; expect exactly 46 ticks after Start.
Box 2: 1 cell, starting at (10, 13, 2); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (4, 13, 3); Player: 1 cell, starting at (4, 14, 3); Box 1: 1 cell, starting at (5, 3, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Ice, Ice slope, Basalt wall.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.
Ticks 2–4 (each tick): Box 0 moves 1 north.
Tick 5: Box 0 moves 1 north and 1 down.
Tick 6: Box 0 moves 1 north.
Ticks 7–9 (each tick): Box 0 moves 1 north and 1 up.
Tick 10: Box 0 moves 1 north.
Ticks 11–12 (each tick): Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 13: Box 0 moves 1 east and 1 down; Box 1 moves 1 east.
Tick 14: Box 0 moves 1 east; Box 1 moves 1 east.
Tick 15: Box 0 moves 1 east; Box 1 moves 1 east and 1 up.
Ticks 16–17 (each tick): Box 0 moves 1 east and 1 up; Box 1 moves 1 east and 1 up.
Tick 18: Box 1 moves 1 east; Box 0 moves 1 east and 1 up.
Tick 19: Box 0 moves 1 east; Box 1 moves 1 down.
Tick 20: Box 1 moves 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 21: Box 1 moves 1 south and 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 22: Box 0 moves 1 south and 1 down; Box 1 moves 1 south.
Ticks 23–25 (each tick): Box 0 moves 1 south; Box 1 moves 1 south.
Tick 26: Box 0 moves 1 south; Box 1 moves 1 south and 1 up.
Tick 27: Box 0 moves 1 south and 1 up; Box 1 moves 1 south and 1 up.
Tick 28: Box 1 moves 1 south and 1 up; Box 0 moves 1 south and 1 up.
Tick 29: Box 0 moves 1 south and 1 up; Box 1 moves 1 south.
Tick 30: Box 0 moves 1 south; Box 1 moves 1 south.
Tick 31: Box 0 moves 1 south; Box 1 moves 1 down.
Tick 32: Box 1 moves 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 33: Box 2 moves 1 west; Box 1 moves 1 west and 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 34: Box 1 moves 1 west; Box 0 moves 1 west and 1 down; Box 2 moves 1 west.
Tick 35: Box 0 moves 1 west; Box 2 moves 1 west; Box 1 moves 1 west.

Tick 39: Box 1 moves 1 east and 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 east and 1 down.
Tick 40: Box 1 moves 1 east and 1 down; Box 0 moves 1 east.
Ticks 41–42 (each tick): Box 1 moves 1 east; Box 0 moves 1 east.
Tick 43: Box 0 moves 1 east and 1 up; Box 1 moves 1 east.
Tick 44: Box 1 moves 1 east and 1 up; Box 0 moves 1 east.
Tick 45: Box 1 moves 1 east; Box 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 46: Box 0 moves 1 down; Box 1 moves 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
